description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would take damage from a critical hit.

Turn an incoming critical hit into a normal one, once per day.

Reduce that damage as though it were a normal hit instead of a critical one.

cinderfall.incomplete: Reduces a critical hit taken from a DIFFERENT creature (an attacker) down to normal-hit damage, once per day, after the attack roll is already known. Blocked twice over: P-DEGREE-REACTIVE (AdjustDegreeOfSuccess resolves before the roll, per adjust-degree-of-success.ts, so it can't react to an already-known result) and P-CROSS (the roll being fixed belongs to the attacker, not the card holder).
